Title: CataTweaks
Author: alex
Description: QoL tweaks: habs named 'Name (Template, Orbit, Body)' on template apply, with save-as-template round-tripping the template name and map icon and overwriting in place; priority presets overwrite and track too; a station filter on the ship construction screen alongside vanilla's body filter. (Code mod; requires Unity Mod Manager. Toggle applies on restart.)
